auth.noAccess: Your account has no access to this system. Ask your firm administrator.

deadlines.title: Deadlines
deadlines.none: Nothing is due in the next 120 days.

entity.firstPeriodHint: The first day of a month. Quarterly periods follow on from it.
entity.goLiveHint: Sales from this date must have an e-invoice. Leave empty if not yet in scope.
entity.partnerThresholdHint: Leave empty if a partner is not needed.
entity.requireReviewer: A tax reviewer must sign off
entity.noEstablishments: No establishments yet. Standard-rated sales need one for their emirate.
entity.name: Name
entity.noMapping: No mapping yet, so every line will be unclassified.
entity.gibanHint: Used to recognise VAT payments on bank statements.
entity.taxYearMonthHint: 1 to 12. Blank means the month of the first tax period.
entity.requireEsignature: The client approves returns by e-signature
entity.noAccess: Has no access to this client
entity.capitalAssetsExplain: Assets of AED 5 million or more excluding VAT are adjusted each year for how far their taxable use has moved.
entity.accessExplain: Who can open this client, and in what role. Being assigned to a client does not give access.
entity.accessAuditorHint: An external auditor's access must end on a date.

period.draftRules: Draft rule pack: the tax team has not signed off these rules. Returns from them are not for filing.

return.none: No return yet. Load data to begin.

section.OUTPUT: VAT on sales and other outputs
section.INPUT: VAT on expenses and other inputs

return.computedBox: This box is calculated from other boxes. Open those to see the lines.
return.noFile: This line did not come from a file.

data.alreadyLoaded: This exact file was already loaded, so nothing changed.
data.fileHint: CSV or Excel, using the template for this data type.
data.ublExplain: PINT AE UBL, one XML or a ZIP of them. These join the reconciliation, and stay not reported until the other provider's Corner 5 status is given.
data.bankExplain: MT940 or CAMT.053. A payment that names the FTA's GIBAN with the amount due settles the return, and one that names a supplier invoice with its amount stops the six-month reversal.
data.bankLoaded: Loaded. {{invoices}} supplier invoice(s) and {{returns}} return(s) settled from it.
data.erpExportExplain: Loads a file from the system's own report, using its column mapping, without reshaping it into a template.
data.corner5Explain: A UBL file does not say whether the invoice reached the FTA. Enter what the other provider's portal shows. Until then, these invoices count as not reported in check R01.

exceptions.proposalsExplain: These look like the same invoice but are not exact. A person must decide, because a near match must not clear a check by itself.
exceptions.timing: Timing items against GL control accounts
exceptions.timingExplain: Differences you expect between the GL and the return. Check R06 takes these into account.

lines.memo: Evidence only, not in the return
lines.recoveryHint: Leave empty to keep the current rate.

review.partnerNeeded: A partner must sign off, because this return is above the threshold or has a waived blocking exception.
review.blocked: This return cannot be approved yet:

adjustments.sixMonthExplain: Reverses input VAT on invoices unpaid six months past their agreed date, and reinstates it once paid. Running it again changes nothing.
adjustments.propose: Propose a journal or deemed supply
adjustments.proposeExplain: Needs evidence, and a second person must approve it before it reaches the return.

filing.notLocked: The return must be approved and locked first.
filing.packExplain: VAT201 values, how to enter each box in EmaraTax, the reconciliation certificate and the approvals. The tool does not submit: a tax agent files on EmaraTax.
filing.draftPack: This pack is watermarked NOT FOR FILING because the rule pack is not signed off.
filing.submitExplain: Record this after submitting on EmaraTax.
filing.nothingDue: Nothing to pay on this return.
filing.noDirect: The FTA publishes no submission API, so a person submits on EmaraTax.
filing.bankCandidatesExplain: These match the amount due or name the FTA's GIBAN. Confirm the one that paid this return.

evidence.explain: Files here cannot be changed or deleted until their retention date.

corrections.notFiled: Corrections apply to filed returns. Before filing, change the open return or withdraw the approval.
corrections.title: Correct a filed return
corrections.explain: Compares the ledger with the filed return. If a line changed, leave the box empty. For an error not in the data, enter the VAT change with evidence. Up to the threshold goes into the next return; above it needs Form 211. The filed return is kept unchanged.
corrections.boxHint: Only for an error not already in the data.
corrections.difference: Tax difference AED {{difference}} against a threshold of AED {{threshold}}.
corrections.payableChange: Payable moves from AED {{from}} to AED {{to}}.

rulePacks.title: Rule packs
rulePacks.explain: The tax rules and the VAT201 form as configuration. A pack stays in draft until the tax team signs it off, and returns from a draft pack are watermarked.
rulePacks.none: No rule pack loaded yet. One is installed when the first return is computed.
rulePacks.newer: Rule pack {{version}} ships with this version and is not installed for your firm. It adds penalties, refunds, schemes and the audit file layout. It installs as a draft, so any sign-off must be given again.

audit.title: Audit log
audit.intact_one: The audit chain is intact: {{count}} event checked.
audit.intact_other: The audit chain is intact: {{count}} events checked.
audit.broken: The audit chain is broken at event {{seq}}: {{problem}}

rule.R01: Sales invoice has an e-invoice reported to the FTA
rule.R02: Issued e-invoice is in the ERP in the same period
rule.R03: Net and VAT match between e-invoice and ERP
rule.R04: Received e-invoice is not in AP
rule.R05: Input VAT claimed without a valid invoice
rule.R06: GL control balances equal the return
rule.R09: Credit or debit note refers to an original invoice
rule.R11: Unpaid six months and not yet reversed
rule.R12: Posted outside the period of its tax point
rule.R13: Emirate split equals total standard-rated supplies
rule.R14: Large swing in a box with no comment
rule.D01: Rows held for a missing FX rate
rule.D04: A locked period has changes to correct
rule.T01: Tax code and place of supply disagree
rule.T03: Input VAT blocked from the description
rule.T04: VAT does not match the expected rate
rule.T05: Seller-side reverse charge: box to confirm
rule.T08: Goods not shown as exported in time

analytics.title: Analytics
analytics.none: There are no returns to show yet.
analytics.netChange: Net VAT changed by AED {{amount}} from the period before.
analytics.anomaliesExplain: Unusual movements against earlier periods. None of these stops approval.

auditCases.title: FTA audits
auditCases.fafExplain: Lists purchases, supplies and the general ledger for a date range, in the layout the FTA publishes for tax accounting software.
auditCases.fafCounts: {{purchases}} purchase lines, {{supplies}} supply lines and {{ledger}} ledger lines.

warning.NO_GENERAL_LEDGER: No general ledger lines are loaded for this range, so that part of the file is empty. Load them as GL journal lines.
warning.LEDGER_NOT_BALANCED: The ledger lines do not balance: debits {{a}}, credits {{b}}.
warning.SUPPLY_VAT_DIFFERS_FROM_RETURNS: VAT on supplies in this file is {{a}}, but the returns show {{b}}. A correction may explain this. Check before sending.
warning.PERIODS_WITHOUT_RETURN: {{a}} period(s) in this range have no return yet.
warning.NO_PERIODS_IN_RANGE: No tax periods fall wholly inside this range.

auditCases.openExplain: Opening a case puts every period in the range, and its evidence, on legal hold.
auditCases.requests: What the FTA has asked for
auditCases.whatGiven: What was given to the FTA
auditCases.bundleExplain: The bundle holds the audit file, the return packs and the evidence, with a manifest of fingerprints so the recipient can check every part.
auditCases.releaseHolds: Release the legal holds this case placed

connectors.title: ERP connections
connectors.unverifiedAll: These mappings come from public documentation and have not been run against a live system. Check a sample before relying on one.
connectors.unverified: Not yet tried against a live system.

disclosure.title: Voluntary disclosure
disclosure.explain: This correction is above the limit for the next return, so it needs a voluntary disclosure on Form 211.
disclosure.notDrafted: No disclosure has been drafted yet.

esign.title: Sign to approve
esign.explain: This client approves returns by electronic signature. It binds your name to these exact figures.
esign.name: Type your full name
esign.consent: I approve this return for filing, and agree that typing my name here is my electronic signature.

exports.title: Export evidence
exports.explain: A zero rate on exported goods rests on official and commercial evidence, with the goods leaving within the time limit.
exports.none: No zero-rated goods exports in this period.
exports.extensionHint: Only if the FTA extended the time limit.
exports.marginExplain: VAT here is the tax fraction of the margin, not of the selling price. Load these sales with the margin template.
exports.noMargin: The scheme was not applied in this period.

penalty.title: Penalty exposure
penalty.note: An estimate as of {{date}} under {{source}}. The FTA decides what is charged.
penalty.noSchedule: No penalty schedule covers this date, so no estimate can be given. Ask the tax team.

code.LATE_FILING_REPEAT: Late filing, repeated within the window
code.VOLUNTARY_DISCLOSURE: Voluntary disclosure, monthly on the tax difference
code.UNDISCLOSED_BEFORE_AUDIT: Not disclosed before the audit notice

practice.title: Practice
practice.noAssignments: Nobody is assigned to a client yet. Assign people on each client's page.
practice.watchExplain: Rolling 12-month taxable supplies for clients not yet registered. AED 375,000 means they must register, and AED 187,500 means they may.
practice.monthStartHint: The first day of the month.
practice.webhooksExplain: Sends signed events when billable work happens. Each is retried with growing gaps until your system accepts it.
practice.secretOnce: Copy this signing secret now, as it is not shown again:
practice.retentionExplain: Records are kept five years from the period end, or fifteen for real estate. Tax records cannot be deleted from the application, and a legal hold stops the clock.
practice.registerExplain: Check R08 warns about any supplier TRN not marked active here. Record what you checked with the FTA: nothing here comes from the FTA automatically.
practice.fxExplain: Runs every day if a feed address is configured. Rates already loaded never change, because lines may have used them.

refund.notRefundable: This return has no excess recoverable tax to claim.
refund.transitional: The usual time limit has passed, so this claim relies on the transitional window. Ask the tax team to confirm it applies.
refund.limitPassed: The time limit for claiming this refund has passed.
refund.fileFirst: File the return first, then claim the refund.
refund.startExplain: This prepares what is needed for {{form}} on EmaraTax. A person submits it there.

schemes.locked: This period is locked. Use a correction instead.
schemes.reviewerOnly: A tax reviewer works with these schemes.
schemes.apportionmentExplain: Works out how much residual input tax can be recovered. In your files, give a line a recovery rate of 100 if it relates only to taxable supplies, 0 if only to exempt supplies, and leave it blank if residual.
schemes.excluded: Capital asset disposals to leave out
schemes.excludedHint: Only used by the output-based method.
schemes.apportionResult: Residual input tax AED {{residual}}, of which AED {{target}} is recoverable. AED {{already}} is recovered so far, so the adjustment is AED {{delta}}.
schemes.further: This annual difference is above the limit, so a further adjustment may be needed. Ask the tax team.
schemes.badDebtExplain: Needs the VAT already filed, the debt written off in the accounts, more than six months since the supply, and the customer told. A second person approves the adjustment.
schemes.badDebtEvidence: Attach the write-off and the notice to the customer.
schemes.noCandidates: No sales invoices are old enough and still unpaid.
schemes.secondPerson: These wait for a second person on the Adjustments tab.
schemes.assetsExplain: Each asset's yearly adjustment goes in the first return after its interval ends.
schemes.recoveryEvidence: Attach proof of the money received.
schemes.recovery: Money received on a relieved debt
schemes.recoveryExplain: If a customer pays after relief was claimed, the VAT on that money is due again in this return. A second person approves it.
schemes.disposalExplain: Settles every remaining year of the asset in this return at once: as fully taxable use if the disposal is taxable, and as no taxable use if it is not.

suggestions.title: Classification suggestions
suggestions.explain: Suggests a treatment for lines no person or mapping has settled, from this client's own history and the rule pack. Nothing changes until a person accepts it.
suggestions.generated: {{examined}} lines looked at: {{added}} new suggestions, {{none}} with nothing to suggest.
suggestions.logged: Each suggestion is logged with its inputs and the version of the rules that made it.

method.HISTORY_COUNTERPARTY: From earlier lines for this supplier or customer
method.HISTORY_GL: From earlier lines on this GL account

errors.ADJUSTMENT_TYPE_INVALID: This kind of adjustment is not allowed here.
errors.AGENT_INVALID: Agency name, TAN, agent name and TAAN are required.
errors.APPORTIONMENT_NO_BASIS: There is nothing to work out a ratio from.
errors.APPORTIONMENT_WRONG_PERIOD: The annual adjustment goes in the first return after the tax year ends.
errors.APPROVAL_BLOCKED: This return cannot be approved yet.
errors.ARCHIVE_TOO_LARGE: The archive is larger than the limit.
errors.ASSET_BELOW_THRESHOLD: The scheme applies to assets of AED 5 million or more, excluding VAT.
errors.ASSET_DISPOSED: This asset has been disposed of.
errors.ASSET_EXISTS: An asset with this reference already exists.
errors.ASSET_INCOMPLETE: Some details of the asset are missing.
errors.ASSET_SCHEME_COMPLETE: This asset has finished its adjustment period.
errors.ASSET_WRONG_PERIOD: This adjustment goes in a different return.
errors.AUDITOR_ACCESS_MUST_EXPIRE: External auditor access needs an end date.
errors.AUDIT_REQUESTS_OPEN: Requests from the FTA are still unanswered.
errors.BACK_TO_OPEN: This return is open, so it needs to be submitted first. If it was in review, the data changed and the sign-offs were cancelled.
errors.BAD_DEBT_DATES: The write-off and the notice must fall on or before the end of this period.
errors.BAD_DEBT_INCOMPLETE: Give the amount and date written off, and the date the customer was told.
errors.BAD_DEBT_NOT_ACCOUNTED: The VAT on this invoice has not been filed yet, so there is nothing to relieve.
errors.BAD_DEBT_NOT_A_SALE: Relief applies to a live sales invoice.
errors.BAD_DEBT_NO_EMIRATE: A line of this invoice has no emirate, so no box can take the adjustment.
errors.BAD_DEBT_NO_VAT: This has no output VAT to relieve.
errors.BAD_DEBT_TOO_EARLY: Relief needs more than six months since the supply.
errors.BAD_DEBT_TOO_MUCH: This is more than is unpaid and not yet relieved.
errors.BANK_TXN_MISMATCH: That bank line cannot settle this.
errors.BANK_TXN_UNKNOWN: That bank line is not on this client's statements.
errors.BANK_TXN_USED: That bank line has already been used.
errors.BEFORE_FIRST_PERIOD: The date is before the first tax period.
errors.BOX_HAS_NO_ADJUSTMENT: This box has no adjustment column on the return.
errors.BOX_IS_COMPUTED: This box is calculated. Correct the boxes it is made from.
errors.COMMENT_TARGET_REQUIRED: A comment needs something to attach to.
errors.COMMENT_TYPE_INVALID: A comment cannot go on that.
errors.CONNECTOR_AUTH_INVALID: That sign-in method is not valid.
errors.CONNECTOR_BAD_RESPONSE: The system's answer was not in the expected form. The mapping may need adjusting.
errors.CONNECTOR_COLUMNS_MISSING: This export is missing columns the mapping needs.
errors.CONNECTOR_EXISTS: This client already has a connection to that system.
errors.CONNECTOR_FILE_ONLY: This system is loaded from its export file, so it needs no connection.
errors.CONNECTOR_KIND_UNSUPPORTED: This connection is not set up for that kind of data.
errors.CONNECTOR_SECRET_REQUIRED: This sign-in method needs a secret.
errors.CONNECTOR_TOO_MANY_PAGES: The system returned too much. Narrow the date range.
errors.CONNECTOR_UNREACHABLE: The system could not be reached.
errors.CORNER5_STATUS_INVALID: That Corner 5 status is not valid.
errors.DEEMED_SUPPLY_BOX: A deemed supply goes in an emirate box, 1a to 1g.
errors.DIRECT_SUBMISSION_UNAVAILABLE: The FTA publishes no submission API. Submit on EmaraTax and record the reference.
errors.DISCLOSURE_EXISTS: This correction already has a voluntary disclosure.
errors.DISCOVERY_DATE_FUTURE: The discovery date cannot be in the future.
errors.DISCOVERY_DATE_REQUIRED: The date the error was discovered is required.
errors.ENTITY_KIND_INVALID: That kind of client is not valid.
errors.ESIGNATURE_NAME_MISMATCH: The name typed does not match the signatory on file.
errors.ESIGNATURE_REQUIRED: This client approves by e-signature: type your name and give your consent.
errors.ESTABLISHMENT_INVALID: Establishment code and name are required.
errors.EVIDENCE_WRONG_ENTITY: That evidence belongs to a different client.
errors.EXCEPTION_LOCKED: This exception is locked with its period.
errors.EXPORT_DATE_INVALID: The export date is too far before the invoice.
errors.FILE_UNREADABLE: The file could not be read.
errors.FILTER_REQUIRED: Give a period or an object.
errors.FIRST_PERIOD_INVALID: The first period must start on the first day of a month.
errors.FORBIDDEN: You do not have permission to do that.
errors.FREQUENCY_INVALID: Filing frequency must be monthly or quarterly.
errors.FTA_REFERENCE_REQUIRED: The FTA's reference for this audit is required.
errors.FX_FEED_FAILED: The exchange rate feed could not be read.
errors.FX_FEED_NOT_CONFIGURED: No exchange rate feed is set up. Rates can still be uploaded.
errors.GIBAN_REQUIRED: The GIBAN payment reference is required.
errors.GROUP_REP_INVALID: The chosen client is not a tax group representative.
errors.GROUP_REP_NOT_ALLOWED: Only group members have a group representative.
errors.GROUP_REP_REQUIRED: A group member needs its group representative.
errors.LINE_NOT_IN_PERIOD: That line is not in this period.
errors.LINK_TYPE_INVALID: Evidence cannot be linked to that.
errors.LOAD_TO_FILER: Load data to the group representative, not a member.
errors.MAKER_CHECKER: A different person must take this step.
errors.MAPPING_EMPTY: A mapping needs at least one entry.
errors.MAPPING_INVALID: Every mapping entry needs a source code.
errors.MATCH_ALREADY_DECIDED: This match has already been decided.
errors.MONTH_INVALID: Give the first day of the month.
errors.NOT_AN_EXPORT: Export evidence belongs on a sale.
errors.NOT_AUTHORISED_SIGNATORY: You are not an authorised signatory of this client.
errors.NOT_A_DISCLOSURE: This correction goes in the next return, so it needs no Form 211.
errors.NOT_REFUNDABLE: This return has no excess recoverable tax to claim.
errors.NO_APPORTIONMENT_METHOD: The rule pack has no apportionment method for this tax year.
errors.NO_DIFFERENCE: The ledger matches the filed return, so there is nothing to correct.
errors.NO_OPEN_PERIOD: There is no open return to take this correction.
errors.NO_RETURN: This period has no return yet.
errors.NO_RULE_PACK: No rule pack is in force on that date.
errors.PARTNER_REQUIRED: A disclosure of this size needs the engagement partner's approval.
errors.PERIOD_LOCKED: This period is locked. Use a correction instead.
errors.PERIOD_NOT_LOCKED: A return pack is produced from an approved, locked return.
errors.RANGE_INVALID: Give a start date on or before the end date.
errors.REASON_CODE_INVALID: That reason code is not valid.
errors.REFUND_EXISTS: This period already has a refund request.
errors.REFUND_TIME_LIMIT_PASSED: The time limit for claiming this refund has passed.
errors.REQUEST_INVALID: A request needs a description and a due date.
errors.RESOLUTION_CODE_INVALID: That resolution code is not valid.
errors.RETENTION_CLASS_INVALID: That retention class is not valid.
errors.RULE_PACK_INVALID: The rule pack is not valid.
errors.RULE_PACK_RETIRED: A retired rule pack cannot be signed off.
errors.RULE_PACK_SECTION_MISSING: The rule pack in force lacks this section. Install a newer one on the rule packs page.
errors.RULE_PACK_VERSION_EXISTS: That rule pack version already exists, and versions cannot be overwritten.
errors.SIGNATORY_INVALID: Signatory name and email are required.
errors.STATEMENT_FORMAT_UNKNOWN: This is not an MT940 or CAMT.053 statement.
errors.STATEMENT_UNREADABLE: The statement could not be read.
errors.SUBMISSION_REF_REQUIRED: The EmaraTax submission reference is required.
errors.SUGGESTION_STALE: This line has changed since the suggestion was made.
errors.TEMPLATE_COLUMNS_MISSING: The file is missing required columns.
errors.TEMPLATE_COLUMNS_UNKNOWN: The file has columns that are not in the template.
errors.TIMING_DESCRIPTION_REQUIRED: A timing item needs a description.
errors.TOO_MANY_LINES: Too many lines for one change.
errors.TRN_ALREADY_REGISTERED: A client with this TRN already exists.
errors.UBL_AED_AMOUNTS_MISSING: A document in another currency needs an exchange rate and an AED tax total.
errors.UBL_FIELD_INVALID: A value in the document is not a number.
errors.UBL_FIELD_MISSING: A required field is missing from the document.
errors.UBL_NOT_AN_INVOICE: This is not an invoice or credit note.
errors.URL_INTERNAL: The address points at an internal network.
errors.URL_INVALID: That is not a valid address.
errors.URL_UNRESOLVED: That host name cannot be found.
errors.USER_EXISTS: A user with this sign-in already exists.
errors.USER_INVALID: Sign-in, email and display name are required.
errors.USER_UNKNOWN: That person is not an active user.
errors.USE_PCT_INVALID: Taxable use must be from 0 to 100.
errors.WEBHOOK_EVENTS_INVALID: Choose at least one event from the list.
errors.WRONG_STATE: This cannot be done at the current stage.
errors.XML_UNREADABLE: The XML could not be read.
